world.description: The vessel is said to have overturned after being hit by strong waves.

US.title: Progressive Peggy Flanagan wins Democratic Senate primary in Minnesota

US.title: Trump-backed Mike Lindell loses primary for Minnesota governor to Lisa Demuth
US.description: Lindell had President Trump's endorsement but he lost to Lisa Demuth, the speaker of the state house. She'll face Democratic Sen. Amy Klobuchar in the fall for governor.

US.description: Sen. Darline Graham, who is serving out the remainder of her brother's term, and Rep. Ralph Norman advance to the special primary runoff later this month.

US.title: The death toll climbs from Monday's 7.4 magnitude earthquake in Colombia
US.description: Hundreds of rescue workers have been deployed in hardest hit cities trying to free victims still trapped under the rubble. Hundreds of people are still missing.
